question: Is there any correlation between ratings and violations among the restaurants?
output_text:
Across the matched restaurant dataset in Salt Lake County, there is only a weak to negligible correlation between customer Google ratings and food health inspection violations:

1. Total Violations (Weak Negative Correlation, r = -0.230 per inspection / r = -0.246 overall): Higher-rated restaurants exhibit a slightly lower overall rate of total violations. Restaurants rated 4.6–5.0 stars average 3.49 violations per inspection, compared to 5.17 violations per inspection for restaurants rated 4.0–4.2 stars and 4.90 for those below 4.0 stars.

2. Critical Violations (Negligible Correlation, r = -0.066 per inspection / r = -0.101 overall): Customer ratings show virtually no meaningful relationship with critical health violations (such as temperature control failures or cross-contamination risks). Restaurants across all rating brackets average between 1.11 and 1.41 critical violations per inspection visit.

3. Inspection Scores (Virtually Zero Correlation, r = -0.041): Health inspection scores (where 0 is clean and higher indicates more severe violations) show no strong alignment with Google star ratings.

Data Coverage Note: Only 139 out of 8,592 total Google Local establishments (1.6%) in the dataset have matched Salt Lake County Health Department (SLCHD) inspection records. Customer reviews primarily evaluate service, ambiance, and taste, which do not reliably signal food sanitation or regulatory compliance.

WITH establishment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.gmap_id,
        e.name,
        e.avg_rating,
        e.num_of_reviews,
        e.slchd_establishment_key,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_violations,
        AVG(i.inspection_score) AS avg_inspection_score
    FROM establishments e
    JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE e.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as matched_count,
    CORR(avg_rating, total_violations) as corr_rating_total_violations,
    CORR(avg_rating, critical_violations) as corr_rating_critical_violations,
    CORR(avg_rating, avg_inspection_score) as corr_rating_inspection_score
FROM establishment_stats;

WITH establishment_stats AS (
    SELECT

        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS violations_per_inspection,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS critical_per_inspection,
        AVG(i.inspection_score) AS avg_inspection_score
    FROM establishments e
    JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE e.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.avg_rating, e.num_of_reviews, e.slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as matched_count,
    CORR(avg_rating, violations_per_inspection) as corr_rating_violations_per_inspection,
    CORR(avg_rating, critical_per_inspection) as corr_rating_critical_per_inspection,
    CORR(avg_rating, avg_inspection_score) as corr_rating_inspection_score
FROM establishment_stats;

WITH establishment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.gmap_id,
        e.name,
        e.avg_rating,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.avg_rating < 4.0 THEN '< 4.0'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.0 AND e.avg_rating < 4.3 THEN '4.0 - 4.2'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.3 AND e.avg_rating < 4.6 THEN '4.3 - 4.5'
            ELSE '4.6 - 5.0'
        END AS rating_bracket,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_violations,
        ROUND(COUNT(v.violation_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id), 2) AS violations_per_inspection,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id), 2) AS critical_per_inspection
    FROM establishments e
    JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE e.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.avg_rating, e.slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    rating_bracket,
    COUNT(*) as num_establishments,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as mean_rating,
    ROUND(AVG(violations_per_inspection), 2) as avg_violations_per_insp,
    ROUND(AVG(critical_per_inspection), 2) as avg_critical_per_insp,
    ROUND(AVG(total_violations), 2) as avg_total_violations,
    ROUND(AVG(critical_violations), 2) as avg_critical_violations
FROM establishment_stats
GROUP BY rating_bracket
ORDER BY mean_rating ASC;

tool_args.query:
WITH establishment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.gmap_id,
        e.name,
        e.avg_rating,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.avg_rating < 4.0 THEN '< 4.0'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.0 AND e.avg_rating < 4.3 THEN '4.0 - 4.2'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.3 AND e.avg_rating < 4.6 THEN '4.3 - 4.5'
            ELSE '4.6 - 5.0'
        END AS rating_bracket,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_violations,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS violations_per_inspection
    FROM establishments e
    JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE e.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.avg_rating, e.slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    rating_bracket,
    ROUND(AVG(violations_per_inspection), 2) AS avg_violations_per_inspection
FROM establishment_stats
GROUP BY rating_bracket
ORDER BY rating_bracket ASC

args.query:
WITH establishment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.gmap_id,
        e.name,
        e.avg_rating,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.avg_rating < 4.0 THEN '< 4.0'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.0 AND e.avg_rating < 4.3 THEN '4.0 - 4.2'
            WHEN e.avg_rating >= 4.3 AND e.avg_rating < 4.6 THEN '4.3 - 4.5'
            ELSE '4.6 - 5.0'
        END AS rating_bracket,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS total_inspections,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) AS total_violations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_violations,
        COUNT(v.violation_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) AS violations_per_inspection
    FROM establishments e
    JOIN inspections i ON e.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE e.avg_rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.avg_rating, e.slchd_establishment_key
)
SELECT 
    rating_bracket,
    ROUND(AVG(violations_per_inspection), 2) AS avg_violations_per_inspection
FROM establishment_stats
GROUP BY rating_bracket
ORDER BY rating_bracket ASC
